sections.text:
This procedure details the testing procedures and calibration I1, which 
 recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.

The TTG 7113 has been designed for the protection of 
 Steam turbine Generators and the power utilization equipment supplied against 
 the risk of excessive under voltages.

The excessive under voltages may occur when large loads are suddenly 
 connected, when the A.V.R does not operate properly or when the under voltage 
 condition is originated by uncleared short circuit fault.

This relay shall be set at the minimum permissible operating voltage and time 
 delayed to allow transient under voltages, originated by sudden increase of 
 loads or by faults condition.

The time delay is necessary to override situations that can be adequately 
 regulated by the excitation system. The TTG 7113 Relay is supplied from a Voltage 
 Transformers (VT) providing secondary voltage to the relay.

The first draft initiated by Eng. Ehab El Khoudary, tested by Eng. Khalied 
 Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo Elwafa at 5 October 2008, and accepted by General 
 Manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby Head 
 Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

The unit (Generator & 
 Transformer) must be out of service.
Secondary Voltage injection test set.
Complete tool set.
Air blower.
Contact cleaner (CRC).

Look at Under Voltage Maintenance file (27) and compare the 
 relay setting with those shown on the test sheet.

Supply the relay with its nominal auxiliary supply: the green 
 LED will light.
Remove the terminals (10,11) from the relay.

Connect the voltage terminals from the injection set to the 
 relay points (10,11).
Increase the injected voltage to 110 V.
Decrease the injected voltage slowly till the pickup value.
Record the P.U value in your test sheet.

Increase the injection voltage till the relay reset ( Drop out 
 Value )
Record the D.O value in your test sheet
Decrease the voltage again to (P.U) value.
Stop the test set.
Restart the test set (with Voltage = P.U value).

The relay will operate, the timer will account and stop when 
 the trip contact close.

Make sure that lock out relays (86GT & 86T) operate with Under 
 Voltage relay operate after its trip time.
Record the time value in your test sheet.

Make reset to the under voltage relay and lock out relays 
 (86GT & 86T).
Increase the voltage to 110 V.
Put C.B of the unit at local position.
Close C.B of the unit.
Return C.B of the unit to remote position.

Trip C.B of the unit by Under Voltage Relay by decreasing the 
 injection voltage.
Stop the tester.

sections_ar.text: توضح هذه الوثيقة بالتفصيل إجراءات الاختبار والمعايرة I1، التي يُوصى بتنفيذها كل عام كما هو موضح بـ Y1 في خانة العنوان.
صُمم طراز TTG 7113 لحماية مولدات التوربين البخاري ومعدات استخدام القدرة المغذاة من خطر نقص الجهد المفرط.
وقد يحدث نقص الجهد المفرط عند توصيل أحمال كبيرة فجأة، أو عند عدم عمل منظم الجهد التلقائي A.V.R بشكل صحيح، أو عند نشوء حالة نقص الجهد بسبب عطل قصر غير مفصول.
ويجب ضبط جهاز الوقاية هذا عند أدنى جهد تشغيل مسموح به مع تأخير زمني للسماح بتنظيم نقص الجهد العابر، الناتج عن الزيادة المفاجئة للأحمال أو عن ظروف الأعطال.
والتأخير الزمني ضروري لتجاوز المواقف التي يمكن تنظيمها بشكل كافٍ بواسطة نظام الإثارة. ويُغذى جهاز الوقاية TTG 7113 من محولات جهد (VT) توفر جهدًا ثانويًا لجهاز الوقاية.

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Ehab El Khoudary، واختبرها م. Khalied Diab وم. Ehab Abuo Elwafa في 5 October 2008، وقبلها المدير العام م. Saad Kheder واعتمدها م. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby رئيس قطاع محطة Mahmoudia Power Station.
